limits: Frozen deterministic 16m mechanism case; no population or disturbance generalization claim
Sampled pose peaks are 20Hz derived diagnostics, not original endpoint scoring
Command reconstruction covers retained 10Hz traces, not all 500Hz controller calls
Historical anchors and frozen source/file hashes require the campaign's separate integrity certificate

mechanism_diagnostics.coordinate_identity_role: Algebraic audit, not independent causal proof; actual tracking remainder is reported separately
mechanism_diagnostics.dominance_role: Geometric hypothesis interpretation only; no task/scoring threshold is introduced
mechanism_diagnostics.local_stability_interpretation: Local corridor departure is distinct from physical instability
